The '''Mairans''' were an [[Water/Legends|aquatic]], multi-[[Limb/Legends|tentacled]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from [[Maires/Legends|Maires]].<ref name="YJK:L" /> They shunned those of their kind with [[The Force/Legends|Force]] abilities, including [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gar Anstak]].<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> They had the ability to stay hours on dry land only if showered periodically by tanks they wore on their backs. They sported two [[Eye/Legends|eye]] membranes, over forty tentacles, and had a [[Music/Legends|music]]-like [[Mairan language|language]] played on a [[shell flute]], but were capable of speaking [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].<ref name="YJK:L" />

The Mairans had a traditional rivalry with the [[Vergill]]s, as evidenced when they established a consulate on [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]] directly on a [[Ditanium/Legends|ditanium]] vein where they knew a [[Vergill]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] company was to begin mining a short while later.<ref name="YJK:L" />
